resources.string: Brings back all settings this game was tested with.
Pick the game\'s NSPs and prod.keys on the computer - this screen follows the build.
%1$s is installed - its icon is on the home screen. Tap it to play.
The build on the computer stopped.

To receive a game:

1. Plug this phone into the computer with a USB cable.
2. On the computer, run the nxnative companion (dm/android/tools/pc_companion.py).

If the computer cannot see the phone, USB debugging needs to be on: Settings, About phone, tap Build number seven times, then Settings, Developer options, USB debugging. A prompt appears on the phone the first time - accept it.
